name: Disable Clipboard Cloud Sync
description: Disables cross-device clipboard synchronization in Windows. Clipboard contents remain available locally, but Windows is prevented from synchronizing them to other devices signed in with the same Microsoft or work account.

description_i18n.en: Disables cross-device clipboard synchronization in Windows. Clipboard contents remain available locally, but Windows is prevented from synchronizing them to other devices signed in with the same Microsoft or work account.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert die geräteübergreifende Synchronisierung der Windows-Zwischenablage. Inhalte der Zwischenablage bleiben lokal verfügbar, werden jedoch nicht mehr mit anderen Geräten synchronisiert, die mit demselben Microsoft- oder Geschäfts-/Schulkonto angemeldet sind.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive la synchronisation du presse-papiers entre les appareils Windows. Le contenu du presse-papiers reste disponible localement, mais Windows ne peut plus le synchroniser avec d'autres appareils connectés au même compte Microsoft ou professionnel.

warnings.title: Cross-Device Clipboard
warnings.message: Applying this tweak prevents clipboard contents from being synchronized across devices. Local clipboard functionality remains available, but cross-device copy and paste will no longer work while the policy is active.

compatibility.notes: Uses the Windows AllowCrossDeviceClipboard machine policy introduced with Windows 10 version 1809. The policy is officially supported on applicable Pro, Enterprise, Education and IoT Enterprise editions.

technical_details: Configures the Windows machine policy HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System\AllowCrossDeviceClipboard. A DWORD value of 0 prevents clipboard contents from being synchronized across devices. Restoring the tweak removes the policy value and returns control to the Windows default or any higher-level policy management. The policy change takes effect immediately and does not require a reboot.
